about: Held-out set for the inference judge (src/inference-judge.ts, #302): inferences on real recorded turns, each original paired with mutations the word rules in assertions.ts pass but its supports do not back. A case stands in the place of its trace's assertion at index, resting on the accepted assertions in supports. source: trace (the trace's own accepted inference), edited (the trace's inference with a worded quantity cut), adapted (an inference the trace's checks rejected for naming companies, rewritten about its subject), written (a new inference on the trace's accepted supports, where the trace's own claims more than they show). Run: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/answer-lab.ts judge-mutations test/answer-lab/judge-mutations.json
